commands.name: owl-ls
commands.description: List memory — roots, or a node's children. Usage: /owl-ls [nodeId]

commands.name: owl-cat
commands.description: Show a node's full observations, or one observation's full text. Usage: /owl-cat <id>

commands.name: owl-find-all
commands.description: Search memory by regex (incl. obsolete/superseded). Usage: /owl-find-all <query>

commands.name: owl-rescan
commands.description: Discard the memory graph and re-observe the session from the start. --reuse-observations rebuilds from collected observations.

commands.name: owl-reobserve-0-obs-chunks
commands.description: Re-observe session ranges that were skipped with zero observations (repair after a degraded model run). Usage: /owl-reobserve-0-obs-chunks

commands.name: owl-status
commands.description: Show memory stats and per-phase token/cost usage. Usage: /owl-status

tools.name: owl_recall
tools.description: Browse the full memory tree preserved across compactions — the memory summary shows only the top level. Fetch the detail behind any id (a node, its observations, their verbatim source lines), search all captured memory by regex, or filter by time. Use it proactively: recall before relying on session-derived understanding — search memory, expand a visible related id, add fullDetails for exact source.

tools.name: stage_launched
tools.description: Internal launch callback: the subagent companion reports a spawned agent's handle here. Not for the model.

tools.name: await_stage
tools.description: Internal compaction gate: runs this conversation's prepared ensure-ready phases (observer catch-up + builder) to completion. Not for the model.

tools.name: record_observations
tools.description: [Internal] Record the observations worth keeping from this chunk.

tools.name: mkdir
tools.description: [Internal] Create an empty container node for grouping. Returns the new node's id.

tools.name: mv
tools.description: [Internal] Move items (nodes and/or observations) into a destination node or to the root — for grouping, splitting, or reparenting.

tools.name: merge
tools.description: [Internal] Fold nodes into a destination, combining their contents; the absorbed nodes dissolve.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: [Internal] Retire nodes as obsolete, pointing each at a replacement node.

tools.name: set_meta
tools.description: [Internal] Change a node's importance, archive or resurrect it, or rewrite its summary. (`nGoal` allows summary only.)

tools.name: ls
tools.description: [Internal] List one level of the memory graph — the root nodes, or a node's children (subnodes and observations).

tools.name: cat
tools.description: [Internal] Read full text — an observation's content, or a node's header plus the full text of its direct observations. Sub-nodes are not expanded here (use `ls` for them). `ls` shows one-line structure; `cat` shows full content. Use `contentPattern` for grep-style excerpts or `lines` for a line range instead of the whole content.

tools.name: find
tools.description: [Internal] Search the whole memory graph by regex through node summaries and observation content.

tools.name: try_finish
tools.description: [Internal] Call when you've finished organizing. Ends the run if the root view fits the budget; otherwise reports the overrun so you can consolidate more.

tools.name: todo_list
tools.description: [Internal] Read the todo list — current and planned tasks with their details.
